counter_semantics.endpoint_count: all batch1 no-gradient rollout endpoints inspected by BVCP
counter_semantics.eligible_transition_count: endpoints where the current residual norm exceeded the one-update-lagged residual norm
counter_semantics.intervention_count: eligible endpoints with a strictly positive chord coefficient
counter_semantics.lambda_sum: sum of the per-endpoint current-to-lagged chord coefficient; zero on identity endpoints

mathematical_diagnosis.observed_operator_shape: For roughly half of stochastic rollout endpoints, the current residual is larger than the previous-update residual. Every such case is projected, while decreases are accepted unchanged; the conditional projection moves increasingly close to the lagged endpoint.
mathematical_diagnosis.asymmetry: The rule suppresses positive update-time changes in rollout residual norm but does not symmetrically correct negative changes, so it is a one-sided temporal derivative constraint rather than an unbiased variance reducer.
mathematical_diagnosis.identity_assessment: Pathwise identity remains valid on non-eligible endpoints, but its frequency does not increase with training and active conditional strength grows from about 0.75 to 0.93. Therefore the registered self-null hope is not empirically realized by e200.
mathematical_diagnosis.revision_constraint: Any allowed revision must change the operator that creates the one-sided temporal bias. A fixed window, scalar decay, later exit, or threshold fitted to paired metrics would only schedule the same bias and is not an admissible repair.
mathematical_diagnosis.parent_mechanism_status: The result diagnoses the frozen BVCP operator only. Whether rollout-distribution speed remains a useful parent mechanism awaits the registered fixed-state target-blind defect audit.
